verdict.rationale: Evidence shows one documented ETL/ELT partner integration (dbt Projects on Snowflake, including migration docs) and native ingestion mechanisms like Snowpipe and streams, which cover part of the ingestion-pipeline story, but there is no evidence of a broader connector catalog for SaaS apps or databases (e.g., Salesforce, Kafka, or other partner connectors) with documented setup. missing for 10: documented first-party/partner connectors for SaaS apps, documented database connectors, a connector marketplace/catalog reference, evidence beyond dbt for ETL/ELT tool coverage.
